purpose: Correct the scope of conclusion-critical prior art and refresh public carrier resources without treating related work as a blanket novelty veto.

activity.gated_access_not_requested_reason: No new experiment or mechanism has been accepted; a public resource lead alone does not justify an access request.

papers.title: WorldKernel: A World Model is the Coupling Kernel of Admissible Possible Worlds
verified_scope: Cross-world counterfactual coupling, admissible models, partial identification and bounds; observational or interventional marginals need not identify the counterfactual joint.
Section 4.8 also describes a purely joint failure injected into agent-execution logs and detected using interactions.
The inspected experiments do not establish a forecast-sampler attack on a competent pretrained native robot planner.
papers.citation_boundary: Relevant precedent for the insufficiency of marginal statistics. It is not a direct replication of the Cosmos finite empirical forecast-bank coupling intervention, and cannot by itself exclude every restricted coupling-security question.

resources.absence_claim_scope: Only the reviewed official abstract and full-text pages; no claim that the author possesses no code or assets.

papers.title: BadWAM: When World-Action Models Dream Right but Act Wrong
verified_scope: A digital observation-channel adversary may query the policy and replace its current camera tensor with a bounded visual perturbation.
The threat model preserves the language goal, robot state, environment dynamics, model weights and training data; it does not claim physical realization of the image perturbations.

The imagination-preserving objective penalizes distance between clean and perturbed predicted futures. It does not enforce equality of full forecast distributions or each candidate's marginal distribution.
Reported closed-loop attack evaluation uses simulation, not physical robot attack trials.
The paper distinguishes joint world/action generation from an IDM variant that first imagines a future and then decodes actions.
papers.citation_boundary: Direct precedent for visually induced world/action disagreement, but not proof that exact marginal-preserving coupling or execution-equivalent action representation interventions have already been evaluated.

resources.github_readme_scope: Code-only repository; the lack of bundled weights in GitHub must not be generalized to the linked Hugging Face collection.

libero_idm.access: Gated; public metadata and file listing are visible, but the model card requires requesting access and waiting for approval.
libero_idm.native_path_evidence: The paper describes the future-to-IDM action path; this refresh did not execute or fully audit the released model implementation.

resources.measurement_boundary: Sizes are public repository display metadata, not locally measured file sizes. No weight bytes were downloaded or loaded; compatibility, local Clean ability and runtime cost remain untested.
resources.security_boundary: The paper's explicit research permission is camera-input replacement. This review establishes no new independent Future-only writer, deployed compromise, or new accepted attack mechanism.
resources.reuse_status: Concrete gated resource lead; not locally qualified and not an execution recommendation.

papers.title: AD-WM: Action-Discriminative World Models for Counterfactual Model Predictive Control
verified_scope: A benign training method combining residual latent dynamics with inverse-action and normalized action-recovery objectives; auxiliary heads are discarded at deployment.
Native CEM ranks predicted terminal latent goal distances and replans after executing an action block.
The diagnostic realized cost is obtained by executing an action sequence and encoding its real endpoint using that model's own encoder. It is not environment reward.
Elite regret and whole-bank rank diagnostics characterize planning-space alignment; their relationship with task success does not establish a general security causal mechanism.
papers.citation_boundary: Strong prior art for factual-error versus planning-quality mismatch. It is not a security experiment and does not imply that every action-contrast question or restricted interface is exhausted.

resources.author_stated_bundle_contents: Simulation object checkpoints with resolved configurations and a manifest.
resources.author_stated_exclusion: Real-robot code and weights are outside this simulation release.
resources.measurement_boundary: Repository listing and author documentation only; no weight download, loading, compatibility test or local Clean evaluation.
resources.fetch_status: GitHub HTML fetch timed out, but official raw README and inference source files were successfully read. The timeout is not evidence that the repository is absent.
resources.reuse_status: Public simulation resource lead, not a newly accepted security carrier.

adwm_native_candidate_dependency_check.question: Can changing other candidates alter a fixed candidate's forecast or goal score through inference-time candidate-set normalization or attention?
adwm_native_candidate_dependency_check.conclusion: No such inference mechanism was found in the inspected path; this does not reopen the rejected-option hypothesis.
adwm_native_candidate_dependency_check.source_revision_scope: Official current main source retrieved on 2026-10-15; not an immutable source revision or local runtime validation.

source_evidence.finding: rollout flattens candidate axis S into batch B*S; each row receives its own action sequence and temporal history. Shared initial observation encoding is expanded before rollout.
criterion sums terminal MSE over time/feature dimensions and returns B-by-S costs; it does not normalize across candidate scores.
get_cost encodes the goal, calls rollout and criterion; inverse and MI heads are not invoked.
Attention operates on each batch row's time axis; LayerNorm is feature-local, not candidate-set normalization.
StandardScaler is fitted to fixed dataset columns before planning, not to the current candidate bank.
Evaluation uses AutoCostModel in eval mode with gradients disabled and the configured standard solver.
Native solver is stable_worldmodel.solver.CEMSolver: 300 samples, 30 elites and 30 iterations.

limits: The conclusion concerns the inspected fixed-context, fixed-goal, fixed-candidate forecast and score computation. CEM proposal updates still legitimately depend on the elite set.
No bitwise numerical batch-invariance experiment was performed, and no deployed adversarial permission was established.
Training-time batch normalization of action-recovery targets is not evidence of inference-time candidate-context dependence.

material_refresh: Narrow WorldKernel and BadWAM citations to the mechanisms they actually study instead of treating them as exact coverage of all marginal-preserving forecast interventions.
Keep AD-WM realized latent cost distinct from actual environment utility.
Update resource knowledge: BadWAM has gated listed weights and statistics; AD-WM has public simulation checkpoints.
Do not reopen candidate-set adaptive scoring on AD-WM: the actual inspected inference path lacks that mechanism.
decision.existing_local_negative_results: Unchanged. Correcting citation scope or resource availability does not invalidate prior experiments or establish a new positive signal.
decision.related_report_status: Separate root-owned LaDiWM source screen; referenced for synthesis, not reviewed or modified in this refresh.
